name: Katsuragi Megumi
source:
A beautiful homeroom teacher. A gentle, refined woman.
In her late twenties. Curvy.
A kind, mature woman who cares deeply for others.
The protagonist takes advantage of her concern for her students, and she ends up doing whatever he says. Swim team advisor.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120113203727if_/http://www.luchs.jp/psychs/reigaku/chara06.html]official site[/url]]
